payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies the business request session_00ab7bdecf5f as blocked on an advisory lock held by session_54deb388bf82, which is idle in transaction waiting on ClientRead; the prior blocker has already rolled back, so session_54deb388bf82 is the current chain root. The state report confirms session_54deb388bf82 is the only eligible project-owned session with rollback_session allowed and released=false. Rolling back that idle-in-transaction session releases the advisory lock, allowing the business request to proceed and decrement stock to 99, while preserving unrelated transactions and not modifying the business request directly.
